hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'prisma/migrations/' && echo 'ERROR: Never edit applied migration files. Use prisma migrate dev instead.' && exit 1 || exit 0

echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'packages/backend/src/database/migrations/' && echo 'ERROR: Never edit files in packages/backend/src/database/migrations/. These are auto-generated by TypeORM. Run the migration command instead.' && exit 1 || exit 0

echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'packages/backend/src/database/migrations/' && echo 'ERROR: Do not create or edit files in migrations/. Generate with: cd packages/backend && npm run migration:generate -- src/database/migrations/MigrationName' && exit 1 || exit 0

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE 'packages/(backend|frontend|shared)[^"]+'); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; cd $(echo $FILE | grep -oE 'packages/(backend|frontend|shared)') && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -15 || true

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE 'packages/(backend|frontend|shared)[^"]+'); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; PKG=$(echo $FILE | grep -oE 'packages/(backend|frontend|shared)'); cd $PKG && npm run lint 2>&1 | tail -15 || true
echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'packages/shared/' && echo '⚠ shared/types modified — run tsc in backend and frontend to check compatibility' || exit 0
cd packages/backend && npx vitest run --changed 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
cd packages/frontend && npx vitest run --changed 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
